content_sections.heading: BHU Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 - 381 Posts
content_sections.text: The largest recruitment category is Nursing Officer , with 381 positions across Sir Sunderlal Hospital, Trauma Centre, other medical units and the National Centre of Ageing. Candidates must possess one of the following nursing qualifications: Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) with five years of Nursing Officer experience in the prescribed hospital setting. B.Sc. Nursing or B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing with at least 55% marks and three years of Nursing Officer experience. Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with at least 55% marks and three years of Nursing Officer experience. The experience must be in a minimum 100-bedded reputed hospital or any Government/Corporate hospital, as specified in the notification. Candidates must also be registered as a Nurse or Midwife with the State Nursing Council. Maximum Age: 35 years, before applicable relaxation. Pay Level: Level 7, Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400. Important: Nursing Officer posts require the prescribed professional experience. Holding a GNM or B.Sc. Nursing qualification alone does not satisfy the complete recruitment eligibility.

content_sections.heading: BHU Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - 29 Posts
content_sections.text: The University has advertised 29 Medical Officer positions under three post codes. Candidates must possess MBBS with a minimum of two years of clinical experience in a Government, Corporate or Government-recognized hospital after completing the mandatory internship. Preference may be given to candidates holding MD/MS/DNB in the relevant advertised specialties, including Geriatric Medicine, Respiratory Medicine, General Medicine, General Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Anaesthesiology, Critical Care or Emergency Medicine. Maximum Age: 40 years. Pay Level: Level 10, Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500. The original notification distinguishes the essential MBBS and experience requirement from the desirable postgraduate qualifications.

content_sections.heading: BHU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age varies according to the advertised position. Eligibility will be calculated as on 15 December 2026 . Reservation, age relaxation and concessions for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates will apply according to Government of India rules. Ex-Servicemen will receive applicable relaxation under Government instructions. The notification also provides the following specific concessions: No age bar for permanent BHU employees. Eligible contractual, project, scheme and daily-wage service at BHU may be considered for age relaxation in Group B and C recruitment. The prescribed conditions include at least one continuous service period exceeding six months for the relevant contractual-service concession. Applicants seeking relaxation must possess the required supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: BHU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure differs between Group A and Group B/C positions. The University may conduct the following stages: Screening of online applications. Written test for shortlisting, if required. Interaction or presentation for further shortlisting, if required. Interview for finally shortlisted candidates. Original document verification. Important: The written examination and interaction/presentation are not mandatory stages for every Group A post. They may be used when considered necessary by the University. Online application submission. Written examination. Skill test for candidates shortlisted from the written examination. Verification of original documents. Final selection according to University recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BHU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready, depending on their selected post: Proof of date of birth. Class 10 and Class 12 certificates and marksheets. Relevant ITI or Diploma qualification certificates. Graduation and postgraduate certificates. MBBS, MD, MS, DNB or equivalent medical qualifications, where applicable. Nursing qualification certificates and State Nursing Council registration, where applicable. Relevant professional registration certificates. Work experience certificates showing the prescribed period and position. SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate, where applicable. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable. Recent photograph in JPEG format, not exceeding 50 KB. Scanned signature in JPEG format, not exceeding 50 KB. No Objection Certificate from the employer, where required. Online application acknowledgement and fee receipt. Other supporting documents prescribed for the relevant post. Shortlisted candidates must produce their original certificates during document verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in BHU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official vacancy tables contain 633 posts across Group A, B and C Medical Sector positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission and fee payment is 15 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What posts are available in BHU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Nursing Officer, Medical Officer, Nursing Superintendent, Deputy Medical Superintendent, Physiotherapist, Technical Assistant, Laboratory Attendant and other medical and technical positions.

faq.question: Q4. How many Nursing Officer vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 381 Nursing Officer vacancies, including female and male positions across regular medical units and the National Centre of Ageing.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for BHU Nursing Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need GNM with five years of relevant experience or B.Sc./Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with at least 55% marks and three years of relevant experience, along with the required Nursing Council registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for BHU Nursing Officer?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, before applicable relaxation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BHU medical non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: Group A may have a written test for short-listing, further interaction/presentation if required, then an interview. Group B and C have a written test followed by a skill test. Short-listed candidates go through original document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay for BHU Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Medical Officer (26004, 26005) and Medical Officer (Specialist) (26006) are at Level-10, with pay matrix Rs. (56,100-1,77,500).

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post in BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, but separate applications must be submitted for different positions.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Applicants in employment should route their application through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer before the interview/selection process, otherwise they may not be considered further.
